classical_sources.allowed_statement: For smooth complex algebraic varieties, algebraic de Rham hypercohomology compares canonically with the usual complex cohomology of the associated analytic/topological space in the algebraic de Rham theorem scope.
classical_sources.author: A. Grothendieck
classical_sources.title: On the de Rham cohomology of algebraic varieties

classical_sources.allowed_statement: For smooth projective complex varieties, the stupid filtration on the de Rham complex yields the classical Hodge filtration under the standard Hodge-theoretic comparison.
classical_sources.author: P. Deligne
classical_sources.title: Theorie de Hodge II

rational_weight2_fact.cycle_inference_forbidden: F^1 membership does not imply existence of an algebraic cycle.
proof: Conjugation-fixed alpha_C in F^1 also lies in conjugate(F^1)=H^(1,1) direct-sum H^(0,2).
Their intersection is H^(1,1); converse is immediate.
rational_weight2_fact.statement: For alpha in H^2(X,Q) in a pure weight-2 Hodge structure, alpha_C is fixed by conjugation; hence alpha is of type (1,1) iff alpha_C lies in F^1.
